These move classification icons (Brilliant, Great, Best, Excellent, Good, Book, Inaccuracy, Mistake, Blunder, Miss) are Chess.com brand assets, taken from the Chess.com brand resources page (https://www.chess.com/article/view/chess-com-brand-resources) and resized to 96 by 96 pixels. They belong to Chess.com and are used here to show move review results in the Chess.com style. They are not covered by this repository's GPL license.
